canonical_work.author: Alpa Shah
canonical_work.title: ‘Keeping the state away’: democracy, politics, and the state in India's Jharkhand
canonical_work.journal: Journal of the Royal Anthropological Institute
canonical_work.scope: Munda political participation and representations of the state in Jharkhand; includes discussion of the sacral polity/parha and local political economy.
canonical_work.scope_classification: Munda-focused Jharkhand evidence; political/ethnographic and temporally/contextually bounded, not a universal cultural rule

identity_verification.publisher: Wiley / Journal of the Royal Anthropological Institute
identity_verification.repository_exact_title_precheck: No exact title match returned by repository code search before insertion.

canonicalization.rule: DOI/publisher landing page, indexing records, citations, and any lawful manuscript/PDF manifestation are one scholarly work unless independently demonstrated otherwise; do not count manifestations as corroborating sources.

access_rights.full_text_status_in_this_run: not established as openly reusable authoritative full text
access_rights.action: Do not ingest or redistribute a binary until lawful manifestation and file-level rights are verified.

evidence_conversion.reason_not_promoted: Publisher metadata/abstract supports work identity and scope but is insufficient for proposition-level controlled cultural evidence. Full-text manifestation, pagination, field/method provenance, primary-versus-secondary dependency, ethics/consent where applicable, and rights remain to be audited.
required_next: obtain a lawful authoritative full-text manifestation
record manifestation identifier and cryptographic hash when permitted
extract only proposition-level passages with exact page/section/table/figure locators
tag direct field/participant evidence separately from author interpretation and cited literature
record field locality, participant/sample and temporal scope where reported
inspect ethics/consent and culturally sensitive political testimony handling
verify file-level reuse/redistribution rights before any binary publication

cultural_uncertainty.generalization_bar: Do not convert the article's locally situated political analysis into a timeless or universal claim about all Munda communities, villages, generations or regions.
cultural_uncertainty.terminology_bar: Retain the author's historical/local terminology and provenance; do not silently normalize institutional or sacred-polity terms across communities.
